data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue for Peapod Lane
data.body:
Hello,

Your fund's most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in ALCO, LMNR, and STHO.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only and never issuer-paid. I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot.

Best,
Andrew

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
